description: List the positions held in a brokerage account with each symbol, asset type, quantity, and average cost. Use refresh=true to request fresh brokerage data when eligible.

account_id.description: ID of the brokerage account to inspect, from get_accounts.

refresh.description: When true, requests the freshest available brokerage data. Real-time refresh requires a Pro plan and has a 1 minute per-account cooldown. Omit or false to return the last synced data.

name: get_holdings
title: Get Holdings
